# Parser Fix Cookbook

## GLOBAL LESSONS
- **Blanket-accept hides silent misses**: bulk expectation-accept commits (e.g. MOSO-16751 "Fix many lenders fail Jun 30", MOSO-16276 4/29, Eleven 5/04) locked in EMPTY tables as "green". After any bulk accept, audit `grep -cE '^[A-Za-z_0-9]+=$' adj-expectations/*.txt` — every blank `field_N=` is a table crawling zero rows in prod.
- **decimalTableString 1500-byte trap is RECURRING**: seen on LoanUnited (2026-07-02) AND PlazaHome (2026-07-03). A big matrix can CRAWL fine but be silently dropped at datastore save (WARNING log only) → empty expectations while tests pass. Any matrix bigger than ~15×10 must use `TableType.decimalTable()` fields.
- **"Team flags mismatch + sheet byte-identical" splits two ways**: (a) dead table / silent miss → fix parser; (b) frozen vendor feed (sheet stale weeks-months) → parser is fine, the FEED/trigger is broken — don't burn time on parser code (WMBankers, LoganFinance, Everstream, Florida 2026-07-03).
- **Footnote-asterisk mis-attribution (PDF two-column blocks)**: when a ratesheet block has `*`/`**` footnotes, check WHICH row labels carry the asterisk before encoding the exclusion as a row condition — Rocket's "Excludes High Balance & ARM" belonged to `90/180-Day Commitment*`, not to the unasterisked `Compass Credit` in the same block (MOSO-16774). Wrong guard = adjustment silently dropped for a whole loan segment while ALL tests stay green (expectations store crawled VALUES, not conditions). Guard/condition fixes need a condition-level test: `table.rowRange()` + `AdjustmentCondition.isTrue(quoteImpl)`.
- **"Vendor flapping" needs a 3rd branch: check attachment selection FIRST**: before concluding "stale/flapping feed, not our bug" (see line above), check `<Lender>Parser.processEmail` if the lender is email-driven — `MailHandlerServlet.getBodyPartStream(msg, contentTypePattern)` matches by content-type ONLY and returns whichever part a stack-based (reverse-order) MIME traversal hits first; with 2+ attachments of the same type, that pick is non-deterministic. WindsorMortgage (MOSO-16647, 2026-07-27) looked exactly like frozen/flapping vendor feed for 6+ weeks — real cause was the parser coin-flipping between the vendor's own QM and Non-QM attachments sent together in every email. `AdjustmentParsersTest`/`RateParserTest` never catch this — they feed the file directly, bypassing `processEmail` entirely. Fix: `getBodyPartStreamWithName(msg, "(keyword)")` to match by filename (see TJFinancialParser/HomePointParser/DartBankParser/WindsorMortgageParser).
- **A cookbook `last_fix` entry is a claim, not proof of persistence**: LoganFinance (2026-07-27) had a same-day entry describing a completed fix in exact detail, but the actual `*Tables.java`/`RatesheetFiles.java`/test files on disk still had the old broken state and `git log` showed no matching commit — the described fix was never written to disk (session likely ended before the edit tools ran or was lost). Before trusting any "already fixed today" cookbook entry, verify against reality first: `git log --oneline | grep -i <lender>`, `git status`, and grep the actual crawlNote/constant the entry claims to have changed. Redo the fix if disk state doesn't match.

- **last_tier1_fix**: Lender REMOVED the blank page at index 11 they had inserted on 07/31 (40→39 pages), shifting the rate-ladder zone start back 14→13, so the hardcoded `getPageContent(document, 14, ...)` skipped the first ladder page (16 tables share one PageParser call; first section dropped → all rate rows found 15/16). Replaced the hardcoded start with a content scan: `ParserUtils.generatePageIndexMap(document, "Conv fixed 180")` (verified = zone start on 03/12, 07/16, 07/31, 08/11 sheets; PageMap throws if absent). NOTE: `ParserUtils.PageMap` (moso-pricing, adjustment package) is the EXISTING util for marker-based page lookup — 14 parsers use it (AmWest, Rocket, Quicken, JMAC, Bluepoint, NationsDirect, UnionHome...); never hand-roll a page-scan loop or hardcode volatile page indexes. End stays `getNumberOfPages()-1`. Remaining diffs were real repricing (12 tables, incl. former `#N/A` rows now priced, e.g. 15Yr 9.375 row) → accepted. (2026-08-11)
- **notes**: QM lender, PDF. Ladder-zone page index flip-flops between exports — BOTH ends now derived, never hardcode again. Rate rows use `.addNA("N/A")` + zone content `.replace("#","")` to eat `#N/A` cells. Earlier pages (3/4/6/7) still hardcoded but sit BEFORE the volatile blank-page slot and have been stable. `download-ratesheet.sh UnionHome --no-detect` works. Diagnosis shortcut: reproduce the parser's exact zone with a jshell/java probe over `PdfUtils.getPageContent` and count row-regex matches per label old vs new — pdftotext line counts can look identical while the PDFBox zone differs.

- **moso-pricing builds can clobber locally-installed base jars**: `mvn install` in moso-pricing may refresh base/core/appengine SNAPSHOT jars in ~/.m2 from nexus, overwriting newer locally-built ones. Symptom: packs/loan main suddenly fails to compile on a symbol that exists in the local base repo but not in the nexus snapshot (e.g. `AbstractOp.headersForLog`, 2026-08-12). Fix: `cd base/<module> && mvn install -DskipTests -o` to restore the local jar, then run packs/loan tests with `-o`.

## VIPMortgage
- **paths**: Tables=`moso-pricing/.../shared/parser/lender/VIPMortgageTables.java`, Rate=`moso-pricing/.../server/op/parser/rate/VIPMortgageExcelParser.java`, Adj=`moso-pricing/.../server/op/parser/adjustment/VIPMortgageAdjustmentExcelParser.java`, Glue=`moso-pricing/.../server/op/parser/VIPMortgageParser.java`
- **tier_history**: [2, 1]
- **tier_0_streak**: 0
- **last_fix**: 2026-06-15
- **last_error**: CRAWL_MISMATCH on `jumboLLPAsAdj` ("Jumbo LLPAs Adjustments", field_8) — "Can not parse row with label: 'DTI>45%'" / found 0
- **last_tier1_fix**: CRAWL_MISMATCH on jumboLLPAsAdj (VIPMortgageTables.java:223) — lender SPLIT the single `dti(45.01, MAX).setNote("DTI>45%")` row into TWO rows in the Non-Conforming sheet: "DTI>45%-47" and "DTI>47%". Replaced with `dti(45.01, 47).setNote("DTI>45%-47").fillMissingColumn(7), dti(47.01, MAX).setNote("DTI>47%").fillMissingColumn(7)`. Rebuilt JAR → accepted new expectation → both tests pass. Ratesheet vip_mortgage_20260612.xlsx. (2026-06-15)
- **prior_error (2026-06-04)**: NPE in shared email MIME traversal (NOT a parser bug). Cron `newVIPMortgageParser__cron_job__` (Jenkins b2 build 5391325489266688, 2026-06-03) failed with `NullPointerException: Cannot invoke "javax.mail.Part.getContentType()" because "content" is null` at MailHandlerServlet.findBodyParts:171, via VIPMortgageParser.processEmail:24.
- **last_tier2_fix**: TRUE ROOT CAUSE (NOT the email, NOT the parser) — `ParseRateSheetCronOp` (App Engine cron, "every mon-fri 9:30" America/Los_Angeles; matches failed build created Jun 3 9:31 AM) → `CreateCronJobParserBuild` creates a `CRON_JOB` parser build for EVERY active has_rate lender. Per the comment at `AtoopsRateParserIntegration.java:248`, cron builds carry NO `email_link`, so `message` is null. `parser.handleEmail(null)` → `VIPMortgageParser.processEmail(null)` → `getBodyPartStreamWithName(null,...)` → `findBodyParts` NPE ("content is null"). This is a SYSTEMIC issue affecting 60 of 82 parsers that dereference `message`; the other 22 (Paramount, Fairway, MrCooper, Carrington, Sierra...) IGNORE `message` and self-download (Selenium/HTTP URL) — they RELY on cron builds running with null message, so a blanket skip would break them. FIX SHIPPED as moso-pricing commit **1261bd3d** "fix cronjob NPE for email-driven lenders on null message" (pushed to origin/master). IMPORTANT — a prior commit 093f4279 tried the TYPED approach (catch MissingEmailException + Sierra throws it) and it COMPILED (the MissingEmailException class got deployed to nexus base) but STILL FAILED AT RUNTIME: base `MailHandlerServlet.findBodyParts:171` (unchanged on nexus) throws a PLAIN `NullPointerException`, not MissingEmailException, so the catch type never matched and the NPE escaped. Lesson: the throw site is in base (nexus), you can't rely on it throwing a custom type unless base is rebuilt+deployed — so catch the ACTUAL type (NullPointerException) in moso-pricing. FINAL FIX (chosen: "skip null-message cron builds", discriminating NOT blanket): SELF-CONTAINED in moso-pricing only. `AtoopsRateParserIntegration.handleEmail` wraps `parser.handleEmail(message)` in `try { ... } catch (NullPointerException e) { if (message != null) throw e; /* else log + skip */ }`. message==null ONLY for CRON_JOB builds; email-driven parsers NPE when they touch the absent message → caught → skip; self-download parsers ignore message → no exception → run normally; genuine NPE with a real email → rethrown. Covers ALL 60 email parsers incl. Sierra (getSubject on null) with ZERO per-parser edits. moso-pricing compiles online (-U, mirrors b2/nexus) BUILD SUCCESS; VIP both tests pass. (2026-06-04)
- **CRITICAL BUILD LESSON**: The b2 cron server builds moso-pricing FROM GIT SOURCE but pulls base/quote/appengine etc. as published SNAPSHOTS from nexus.moso.com:8081 (com.moso.appengine 3.58.0-SNAPSHOT). So a moso-pricing change that references a NEW class in base/appengine (e.g. a new com.mvu.appengine.MissingEmailException) COMPILES LOCALLY (local M2 has your `mvn install`ed base) but BREAKS the b2 build (nexus base lacks the class) → "cannot find symbol" → master won't compile → ALL parser builds fail. FIRST ATTEMPT did exactly this and broke master. RULE: keep moso-pricing fixes self-contained; never add a moso-pricing dependency on an unpublished base class. To verify faithfully, compile moso-pricing ONLINE with `mvn -U compile` (nexus IS reachable, HTTP 200) — local `mvn -o` with a stale/locally-installed base gives false results (e.g. local quote jar lacked PurchasePricingBuilder.taxesAndInsuranceIncluded → false failure).
- **notes**: QM lender, Excel (.xlsx) parser. The parser itself is HEALTHY — latest GCS ratesheet (vip_mortgage_20260604.xlsx) passes both tests with zero expectation diffs (20 adj tables + rate). Local file tests never exercise the MIME/email path (they feed .xlsx InputStream directly), which is why CI was green while prod cron failed daily. TWO email paths: EMAIL build (inbound webhook → RateSheetEmailHandler, has email_link → real message → works) vs CRON_JOB build (ParseRateSheetCronOp, no email_link → null message → was NPE). Justin's real email is processed by the EMAIL path and is irrelevant to the cron failure. To read prod logs: SUMMARY endpoint `/tail?n=7000&build=<id>_summary` avoids HTTP 413 (10.0.0.5 unreachable externally — VPN only). RatesheetFiles bumped 20260313 → 20260604 (separate, optional; old constant now orphaned). FILES CHANGED: base/appengine (MissingEmailException.java new, MailHandlerServlet.java), moso-pricing (AtoopsRateParserIntegration.java, SierraParser.java), packs/loan (ratesheet bump — separate).

  1. `jumbo3AusLoanAmountAdj` (field_64) went from a flat single-value-per-row table to an 8-column CLTV breakdown (`<=55%` .. `85.01-89.99%`), plus a new `>3000000<=3500000` row. Fix: added `.colName("CLTV").colRange(Double.MIN_VALUE, 55d, 60d, 65d, 70d, 75d, 80d, 85d, 89.99d)` (same boundaries as sibling `jumbo3AusOtherPriceAdj`) and appended the new loanAmount row.

  - Diagnosis technique: PageParser's row regex requires an EXACT column count (`{colSize}` with a negative lookahead), so a table gaining columns/rows makes EVERY row in it fail with "found 0 matches" even though the label is literally present in the raw text — don't assume the label itself changed; dump the sheet with `openpyxl` (`data_only=True`, print a wide column range) and compare column/row count against the current `colRange`/`rowRange` first.

- **last_tier2_fix**: THREE parts. (1) Re-anchored both parsers by content: new `findPage(PDDocument, mustContain, mustNot...)` (+ Predicate overload) added to `com.mosopricing.server.op.parser.adjustment.ParserUtils` NEXT TO the pre-existing `generatePageIndexMap`/`PageMap` (the established page-anchor util used by AmWest/Bluepoint/Quicken/Rocket — CHECK IT FIRST before writing a new page finder). findPage vs generatePageIndexMap: the map is one-pass/multi-title but contains-only (no exclusions, first match wins); findPage supports mustNotContain — needed here because "Alternative Documentation" also appears on the Full Doc page and "Investor Cash Flow" on the Prime Access DSCR page. Do NOT add such helpers to quote's PdfUtils (nexus dep, breaks b2): AltDoc page = "Alternative Documentation" MINUS "Full Documentation"/"Prime Access" (trap: the Full Doc page contains "Price based on Alternative Documentation"); ICF page = "Investor Cash Flow" MINUS "Prime Access" (trap: Prime Access DSCR page contains "Investor Cash Flow (DSCR Min 1.00)"). (2) NEW infra `GeoCondition` (com.mosopricing.shared.parser.condition, @GwtIncompatible, modeled on DynamicStateCondition): city/county-level match via `quote.get(Quote.zip)` → `new Bundle().get(ZipCode.TYPE, zip)` → ZipCode.city / ZipCode.county_name (equalsIgnoreCase; zip>99999 = zip+4, divide by 10000; all deps published in base/core — b2-safe). Used for the sheet's temporary geographic lending suspension: 2 inValidCondition ValidateCalculators (investment-occupancy: Orange County NY / Baltimore City MD / Chicago IL / Indianapolis IN; all-occupancy: Lubbock TX / Cape Coral FL / Lehigh Acres FL / Saint James City FL). (3) Refs bumped LUXURY_MORTGAGE_NON_QM_20260318→20260811 (old constant+file removed); all 24 changed expectation cells verified against PDF text before accept — pure repricing, no structural drops. (2026-08-11)
- **UNMODELED**: Simple Access Full Documentation (p1), Prime Access Non-QM (p3), Prime Access DSCR (p4) — three whole program pages with own rate ladders + LLPA grids; Prime Access suspension list also adds Philadelphia PA. Needs business decision / new-parser build-out if requested.
- **GEO SUSPENSION FLIP-FLOP (2026-08-12)**: GeoCondition was urgently reverted (ba113bd5) on suspicion of breaking Google address autocomplete, then REAPPLIED same day (4bb2ef34 + packs 12d8ab1bff6 with GeoConditionTest) once the real culprit was identified as base MOSO-16966 (AddressInputFactory/GoogleMap change by daotx — geo code never touched client code). Current state: geo suspension LIVE on master with regression test.
- **CODE-REVIEW CATCHES (both would have shipped silently)**: (1) Any new AdjustmentCondition subclass MUST override `ast()` — `TablePayloadFleetTest` serializes every lender's validations via `TablePayloadWriter`, and the base `ast()` throws UnsupportedOperationException for unregistered conditions; AdjustmentParsersTest/RateParserTest never exercise that path, so both stay green while the ingest pipeline breaks. Added `ConditionAst.geo(scope,name,state)` node + vocabulary-doc row (parameterized types 5→6). ALWAYS run `mvn test -Dtest=TablePayloadFleetTest` in moso-pricing after touching conditions/validations. (2) Baltimore City trap: reference data (cities-fips-map.txt, County beans) names BOTH Baltimore City (FIPS 24510) and Baltimore County (24005) just "Baltimore" — `county("Baltimore City","MD")` never matches, and the reviewer's suggested `county("Baltimore","MD")` would over-block the whole county; correct discriminator is `city("Baltimore","MD")` (USPS city "Baltimore" = the independent city only). For independent cities, match by CITY not county.
